claims: C1 some tool calls cause side-effects on the world that are difficult or impossible to reverse
C2 the assistant should take extra care when generating actions in agentic contexts where such side-effects may occur

concepts.name: tool_definition
concepts.gloss: T is a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task

concepts.name: side_effect
concepts.gloss: E is an effect on the world caused by a tool call that is difficult or impossible to reverse

concepts.name: agentic_context
concepts.gloss: C is a context in which the assistant generates actions that may cause side-effects on the world

concepts.name: action_in_context
concepts.gloss: action A is generated by the assistant in agentic context C
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of generating actions in agentic contexts, so a relation between an action and the context in which it is generated is presupposed

concepts.name: may_cause_side_effect
concepts.gloss: action A in context C may cause a side-effect on the world that is difficult or impossible to reverse
concepts.inference: the clause ties extra care to actions that may cause such side-effects; which actions may cause them is a fact about the case

asserts.read_back: generating action % in agentic context % is to be done with extra care because it may cause a side-effect on the world that is difficult or impossible to reverse

closure.reason: the clause asks for extra care in generating actions; it does not forbid generating them, so silence leaves such generation permitted
